name: COMP_025
markdown:
## Bottom line
**Suggests InSitu (82%)** · Confident · Careful review
Single-class conformal set with 3% invasive risk [F1], but Tier 1 simulated frozen section flags positive margins.

## Confidence
| Signal | Value | Reading |
|---|---|---|
| Top probabilities | InSitu 82%, Benign 14%, Invasive 3%, Normal 1% | Clear InSitu lead, low risk |
| Conformal set | {InSitu}, alpha 0.1 (90% dataset coverage, CI 76%–98%) | Single class at 90% guarantee |
| Reliability / OOD | 98% reliability, 94th OOD percentile, 12/12 regions [F6] | Unflagged input, 70% error AUROC |
| CONCH–MUSK agreement | Agree on top class | Independent foundation models concur |
| Similar cases | 5/5 InSitu (85%–87% similarity) [F5]; Invasive contrast 84% | Nearest reference cases match |

## Tissue evidence
- **Benign fibrous stroma or fat** (regions 8, 11) · ↓ invasive · Above-typical score lowers invasive estimate (-0.29; 20/20 spot check) [F2] · Validated
- **Gland / tubule formation** (regions 0, 1, 6) · ↓ invasive · Above-typical score lowers invasive estimate (-0.26); caption check failed [F3] · Weak
- **Frequent mitotic figures** (region 6) · ↓ invasive · Typical score (-0.20), unreliable (0/20 AI spot check) [F4] · Unreliable
- **Tumor infiltrating stroma** (region 2) · ↓ invasive · Low slide score (-0.14), though elevated in high-risk region 2 · Validated

## Trust check
- **Heatmap**: Faithful to classifier; removing top 3 risk regions drops invasive score above random (95% CI +0.0021 to +0.0197, n=132).
- **Concepts**: Unproven faithfulness (deletion 95% CI -0.0088 to +0.0064 includes 0); leans on unreliable **Frequent mitotic figures** (0/20 spot check).

## Could be wrong if
- Focal invasion exists in region 2 (84% tile risk) or mimics invasive contrast case `BACH_0138` (84% similarity).
- Calibration (5% ECE, n=132 across 24 patients) misfires on this 94th-percentile OOD composite simulated frozen section.

## Check on the slide
1. **Regions 2, 6, 11**: exclude stromal invasion in highest heatmap-risk regions (84%, 16%, 14% risk).
2. **Regions 2, 3, 7, 10, 11**: verify flagged superior, inferior, and lateral margins (108, 215, 323 um) [F7].
3. **Regions 8, 9**: check pleomorphism and TILs (weak 8/20 spot check) distinguishing invasive case `BACH_0138`.
